name: modern-eq
description: A Spicetify extension that replaces Spotify's stock equalizer with a modern multi-band EQ panel with regions, presets, and live curve visualization.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && copy dist\modern-eq.js "%APPDATA%\spicetify\Extensions\" && spicetify apply
scripts.release: npm run build && copy dist\modern-eq.js builds\modern-eq.js

author: 7xeh
